text:
sara-chen: thanks folks — quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime segment. two asks: 1) what's the canary timeline for kernel v5? 2) short-term mitigations for the kv-cache eviction spikes we saw on low-latency buckets? i'll collect answers here.

jason-roberts: kernel v5 canary is gated on two remaining perf tests. aiming for a small canary next week (us-west first), full canary across regions the week after. will post exact canary-id when started. :clock1:

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: kernel-v5 canary queued for us-west-2. canary-id=canary-9842. status=queued.

anita-garcia: eviction spikes look correlated with sudden short-lived bursts of long-prefix prompts that bypass prefix cache. short fix: bump the per-pool reserve from 0.20 -> 0.35 and enable aggressive prefix fold for 1 hour on the affected pools. that reduces churn while we root-cause.

jason-roberts: adding to anita — we also saw the kernel allocation heuristic mis-predicting seq_len distribution for the burst. will push a heuristic tweak that errs on smaller initial allocations to avoid large KV churn. low-risk patch; canarying with v5.

trevor-moss: on batching: ops team measured benefits from dynamic microbatching for tail SLOs. short term, we suggest enabling dynamic_microbatch:true and target_batch_size: 32 for low-latency customers. that drops p99 without hurting p50.

maya-singh: i put a quick dashboard with the eviction/seq_len heatmap here: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/runtime/eviction-heatmap — shared with runtime leads. please ping if you need dashboard perms.

anita-garcia: config snippet to try (ops can roll out per-pool):
```yaml
pool_config:
  reserve_fraction: 0.35
  dynamic_microbatch: true
  target_batch_size: 32
  prefix_fold_window_secs: 3600
```

trevor-moss: note: target_batch_size=32 is a guideline; some pools with short seq_len workloads can go lower. we'll add an auto-tune job next sprint.

sara-chen: great, thanks. jason/anita/trevor — can you post PRs or runbooks for these changes by EOD Friday? i'll use those notes for a short customer-facing follow-up doc.

jason-roberts: will do. PR for heuristic tweak and canary schedule coming today.

anita-garcia: runbook draft in progress, will drop link here once editable. covers rollback steps and how to monitor eviction rate.

deploy-bot: Canary started: kernel-v5 canary-id=canary-9842 in us-west-2. status=running.

maya-singh: added a short alert rule (temp) to notify #eng-runtime when eviction_rate > 0.08 for 5m. we can tune or remove after stabilization.

sara-chen: thanks all — i'll set a 30m follow-up sync tomorrow to review canary telemetry and decide rollout cadence. posting calendar in 10. :calendar:
